title: Lunch Menu
text:
The menu has three soups. Today there is tomato soup, chicken soup and vegetable soup. The soup is hot. Sam orders chicken soup because he is hungry.

Anna orders a salad and water. The salad is big and green. The water is free. Anna likes the salad very much.

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about her salad?
Why might this restaurant be a good place for lunch?
options: It has many choices and free water

vocabulary.definition: a list of the food and drinks that a restaurant serves
a dish of mixed vegetables, often eaten cold

paragraph_translations: El menú tiene tres sopas. Hoy hay sopa de tomate, sopa de pollo y sopa de verduras. La sopa está caliente. Sam pide sopa de pollo porque tiene hambre.
Anna pide una ensalada y agua. La ensalada es grande y verde. El agua es gratis. A Anna le gusta mucho la ensalada.
